name: Vilamalla (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow saltire of Saint Vincent, accompanied by two crossed keys above and two yellow wheels at the sides.
history: The official flag of Vilamalla is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a yellow saltire called of Saint Vincent, accompanied by two keys in saltire with their wards upwards and outwards, and two wheels; the saltire is 1/6 of the height wide, equal to the diameter of the wheels.

features.role: saltire of Saint Vincent, 1/6 of the height
two keys in saltire above the crossing
wheels at the hoist and fly
